whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Googly 11 Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has solid local engagement in Phulwari Sharif, Patna, but currently relies on third-party marketplace links instead of a dedicated direct ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct online menu, WhatsApp table reservation, aur fast mobile ordering integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/googly11

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Googly 11 Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a direct mobile menu and WhatsApp table booking for your Phulwari Sharif location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
